work.name: MOSAIC
work.expansion: Mass-spec Oligo Sequence Assignment, Impurity and Comparability
work.summary: Analysing oligonucleotide medicines used to mean several software packages, calculators and hand-built spreadsheets, repeated by every analyst. I built a suite of analysis tools and combined them into MOSAIC, one app that goes from the raw instrument file to the report.
points: Reads Thermo Orbitrap raw files directly, with no manual export
Optimises MS methods, sequences oligonucleotides, finds impurities and compares batches
Assigns each observed mass to the most likely impurity within a ppm tolerance, then confirms it with MS2 fragment matching and a confidence label
Exports straight to Excel, PDF and PowerPoint
Automated pytest suite, UI and output audit scripts, versioned releases and a standalone Windows build
work.result: Each analysis takes half the time, so the same team takes on twice the projects.

work.name: FIL
work.summary: A scheduled pipeline that finds new experiment records in LabWare and Databricks, pulls the chemical structures and instrument settings out of the attached slide decks, and loads them into a database built for searching.
work.result: Years of fragment records, searchable, with zero manual steps.
